text: The convention requires that the master notify the authority immediately.
The regime requires that every vessel calling at a member port be liable to inspection.
It recommends that all crew members complete the relevant drill before departure.
It is essential that it stay that way.
The convention requires that the master notify the maritime authority immediately.
Detention follows only where the vessel is not, in the view of the officer, seaworthy.
It is essential that the standard be independent of the thing it measures.

I am asked constantly whether I enjoy detaining ships. I have detained eleven vessels in nine years, and I did not enjoy any of them. What people misunderstand is how narrow my decision actually is. I record what I find. If a lifeboat release gear has not been serviced, that is a deficiency and it goes on the record whether the master agrees with me or not. What I do not decide is whether it matters. The regime requires that any deficiency found be recorded against the ship, and it requires that detention follow only where the vessel is not seaworthy. Those are two different sentences and I am only responsible for the first one. The second is reviewed by a person in an office who has never seen that ship, and that is not a weakness of the system. It is the whole design.

In the first block I told you that marks go on degree, agency and register. In the second block a fourth appears, and it is the one that separates the good candidates from the very good ones. It is structure. A relative clause attached to the wrong noun, a cleft that you read as an ordinary sentence, a subjunctive that you take for a typing error. None of those is a vocabulary problem, and none of them can be fixed by reading faster. They are fixed by slowing down at exactly four places: after a comma that introduces a which, after the word that, before any verb that has no ending, and at the first word of a sentence that begins with a negative adverb. Four places in a whole paper. That is the entire technique, and candidates who use it stop losing the marks they were losing.
